tool_input.body: Fixed in 829ca61, with follow-ups in 3aad6de and d85107b. The id is now consumed the moment the claim-forked-pending record write returns without error. `releaseID(false)` is not called on any later failure path: skeleton write, post-check, binding, claim, mark, or in-process cleanup. A record write that fails leaves no durable record, so it still releases the id. This is §5 point 2 item 3 of `docs/design-opencode-plugin.md`, mirrored in DES-078 item (29a). It is listed as a review finding the model does not cover: the spec's new limit N20 states that the model never returns an id to the counter. The required test is: the record write succeeds and the skeleton write fails; a second dispatch allocates an id, which must differ; the child's retry finds its record not resumable, because its skeleton was never written, removes the record, and allocates a fresh id. That retry never binds to the second dispatch's skeleton.

tool_input.body: Confirmed and fixed. ProB reproduces the trace exactly, with all fifteen fixes on, on the claim slice plus the unlocked sweep: counterexample at 8,744 states, depth 12 (c1988e6). The spec adds a sixteenth switch, `fixResumeClosed`, and records the trace as ledger entry C16. On the resume path, a mission found closed makes `LcCfExitNoRetry` close the open dkFork skeleton the record names, which the child owns, with verdict aborted. The close is compare-and-set on open, under the delegation lock. Only then is the record removed and the call exits "do not retry". If the close fails, the call ends "write failed" and the record is kept as the retry token. The gap is closed by two new exhaustive slices, claim-u and claim+u, which add both halves of the unlocked sweep. All eight reachable invariants hold on them with sixteen switches on: 120,609 and 515,801 states, all visited, plus 911,073 states with three delegations. The mutants for the new switch are killed. jra evaluated the result independently and accepted it. The design (§5 point 2 step 6, the exit-status table) and DES-078 now match (829ca61 onward).
